import type { GameEvent } from '@src/types/event';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { getBackendRobotIdentity } from '@src/api/bot/identity';
import { runBackendTaskRuntimeAction } from '@src/api/bot/task-runtime-action';
import { normalizeTaskCommandText, sendPage, sendShortcut, toTaskRouteCommand } from '@src/response/task/common';
import type { Next } from 'alemonjs';
import { Format } from 'alemonjs';

export default async (e: GameEvent, next: Next) => {
  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const identity = await getBackendRobotIdentity(e.UserId, request);

  if (identity.account.status !== 'registered') {
    next();

    return;
  }
  const text = normalizeTaskCommandText(e.MessageText);
  const match = text.match(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?任务\s+(.+)$/);

  if (!match) {
    next();

    return;
  }
  const result = await runBackendTaskRuntimeAction(e.UserId, identity.account.playerId, 'continue', match[2] ?? '', undefined, request);

  if (result.outcome === 'started' && result.command) {
    return sendShortcut(e, result.command, result.message);
  }
  if (result.outcome === 'expected' && result.command) {
    return sendShortcut(e, result.command, result.message);
  }
  if ((result.outcome === 'next' || result.outcome === 'completed') && result.executed) {
    if (result.outcome === 'next' && result.command) {
      sendShortcut(e, result.command);
    }
    e.MessageText = toTaskRouteCommand(result.executed);

    return next();
  }
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText(result.outcome === 'invalid_runtime' ? '当前任务已失效，请重新发送 /任务执行 <槽位>' : '当前没有进行中的任务，请先发送 /任务执行 <槽位>');
  sendPage(e, '任务执行', md);
};
